Predict with a trained flexynesis model on the test cohort

Source: R/flexynesis.R
test_flexynesis.Rd

Exports the test cohort to the flat inference layout and runs flexynesis in inference mode against the model + artifacts from train_flexynesis.

Usage

test_flexynesis(
  training_result,
  X_test_list,
  y_test,
  tmpdir = tempfile("flexynesis_infer_")
)

Arguments

training_result

List returned by train_flexynesis.

X_test_list

Named list of test omics matrices (samples x features).

y_test

Data frame of test survival data; row names are sample IDs. clin.csv is written from this so known labels are available, but it is not required for prediction itself.

tmpdir

Working directory for the exported test data; fresh by default.

Value

A list with pred: the test-set predictions, ordered to match rownames(y_test).

See also

train_flexynesis, run_flexynesis_inference
